The union of the Who's On First region records Ampāra (85673733), Maḍakalapuva (85673737), Trikuṇāmalaya (85673747). A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 25 records, at least 89 percent of those places are under one division.
